notes: Exalted: The Abyssals reviewed cover-to-cover for player-facing mechanics (Chapters One through Six), plus the supplement The Book of Bone and Ebony. 440 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/. Core book (287 rows): the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, all 228 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for all five Castes, the complete 26-spell necromancy system across all three circles (Shadowlands 9, Labyrinth 9, Void 8), 4 of 5 Crafts of the Dead, and a confirmed absence of Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws. The corpus-rending-blow prerequisite gap was resolved, unblocking ghost-warding-glyph. Book of Bone and Ebony supplement (153 more rows): 77 new necromancy spells, a 69-entry artifact catalog (Wonders of the Dead), 5 named artifacts plus 1 embedded spell from the Creations of Bone chapter, and an excluded finding for its Arts of the Dead chapter (ghost Arcanoi, not player Charms). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. A handful of Chapter Five rows still need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass, two Chapter Five rows and two supplement spell rows (brick-by-brick-solitude, barred-tomb, marked unresolved for missing mote costs) need follow-up before promotion (see source-manifest.json rulesNotes). Book of Bone and Ebony's Chapter Four nemissary/war-machine construction subsystem is not yet transcribed. Chapter Six's ghost/NPC Arcanoi trees, Chapter Seven's Storytelling material, and the Blood and Salt supplement remain out of scope/untriaged. Locked pending remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
